t: ff.115 The year of the snake / 1
st: What will we do when we grow up? Not even billionaires know.

sec.t: ff.115.1 A lesson with a billionaire
sec.p: I'm in China right now, and Chinese is DeepSeek, the open source model that makes free what OpenAI offered for €200/month (🍓 ff.103.1 Think before you speak).

sec.t: ff.115.2 What to study with ChatGPT around?
sec.p: As a good investor, Chris Sacca follows tech trends closely. With podcasts? No. By talking to ChatGPT for hours (after asking it to impersonate Buckminster Fuller, 🎼 ff.48 Resurrecting Aristotle).
Speaking of snakes. Artificial intelligence is slithering out of chatbots and into practical applications.
